title: Setup Database so users can register
description:
Provision the PostgreSQL instance, schemas, and roles the registration feature depends on. The database must accept the migration set from clc-prev.3 and pass the connection smoke test from clc-prev.4 before this bead closes.

## MoC

| # | AC | MoC | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | App connects via the configured role | integ | smoke test script returns 0 |
| 2 | Migrations apply cleanly | integ | rake db:migrate exits 0 |
acceptance_criteria:
- Application can open a connection using the configured role and run a SELECT 1 successfully
- Migration set from clc-prev.3 applies without error

metadata.intent: Make the database substrate ready for the registration flow. Scope IN: PostgreSQL instance, schemas, app role, migration baseline. Scope OUT: backup, replication, monitoring.
